user.title: Connect to a Brilliant panel
user.description: Enter the panel's address and its SSH login: a password, a private key, or both. Nothing is sent before you have confirmed the panel's SSH host key (trust on first use).

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the panel.
data_description.port: SSH port of the panel, normally 22.
data_description.password: SSH password of that user. Optional when you paste a private key.
data_description.expected_fingerprint: Paste the panel's SHA256 host key fingerprint (SHA256:...) to verify it up front (ssh-keygen -l -E sha256 -f /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub on the panel) and skip the confirmation step. MD5 fingerprints are not accepted.
data_description.private_key: The whole text of an unencrypted OpenSSH or PEM private key (the panel must have the matching public key in authorized_keys). Optional when you enter a password.

install.title: Install the kiosk
install.description: The kiosk is not installed on this panel. Home Assistant can install the latest stable release with ha-kiosk-setup, but only a release whose checksum is built into this integration. Create a long-lived access token (profile page) for the panel and paste it here, and enter your MQTT broker's address and login (they are not read from Home Assistant's MQTT settings). {error}

data.ha_url: Home Assistant URL for the panel

data_description.install: Untick to add the panel for monitoring only.
data_description.ha_url: An address the panel can reach on your network, starting with http:// or https://.
data_description.mqtt_host: Host name or IP address of your MQTT broker. The panel publishes its entities there (built-in kiosk MQTT).
data_description.mqtt_password: Must not contain ' " $ ` or \ : the panel keeps it in a settings file that shell scripts read, so these characters are refused.
data_description.mqtt_user: Must not contain quotes, backslash, $ or a backtick.
data_description.token: A long-lived access token, created on a Home Assistant user's profile page (Security tab). The kiosk on the panel uses it to talk to Home Assistant; it is kept on the panel, readable only by root.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to the panel again
reauth_confirm.description: Home Assistant cannot log in to {host}. Enter the new SSH password, or paste a private key. They replace the stored credentials.

data_description.password: SSH password. Optional when you paste a private key.
data_description.private_key: The whole text of an unencrypted OpenSSH or PEM private key.

data_description.host: The new address should reach the same panel. A different SSH host key is shown for your confirmation.
data_description.port: SSH port of the panel at the new address, normally 22.

host_key.title: Confirm the panel host key
host_key.description:
The panel at {host} presented this SSH host key fingerprint:

`{fingerprint}` ({key_type})

Compare it with the key on the panel before continuing. Submitting pins this key; the SSH password is only sent to a panel that presents it.

reauth_host_key.title: The panel's host key changed
reauth_host_key.description:
The panel at {host} now presents a different SSH host key than the one pinned.

Pinned: `{old_fingerprint}`
Now: `{fingerprint}` ({key_type})

This is expected after the panel was reset or re-flashed. If you did not expect it, something else may be answering at that address: do not confirm. Confirming pins the new key; your credentials are asked for next and only sent to a panel that presents it.

data.trust_new_key: I checked the new host key and trust it

data_description.trust_new_key: Tick this only after you compared the new fingerprint with the key on the panel (ssh-keygen -l -E sha256 -f /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub). Confirming replaces the pinned key.

reconfigure_host_key.title: The new address has a different host key
reconfigure_host_key.description:
The panel at {host} now presents a different SSH host key than the one pinned.

Pinned: `{old_fingerprint}`
Now: `{fingerprint}` ({key_type})

This is expected after the panel was reset or re-flashed. If you did not expect it, something else may be answering at that address: do not confirm. Confirming pins the new key and the stored credentials are used to log in.

data.trust_new_key: I checked the new host key and trust it

data_description.trust_new_key: Tick this only after you compared the new fingerprint with the key on the panel (ssh-keygen -l -E sha256 -f /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub). Confirming replaces the pinned key.

error.host_key_mismatch: The panel's SSH host key does not match the pinned key.
error.invalid_value: A value is not allowed in kiosk.env: {error}
error.auth_required: Enter a password or paste a private key.
error.invalid_characters: This value must not contain quotes, backslash, $ or a backtick.
error.invalid_url: Enter an address starting with http:// or https://.
error.host_key_not_confirmed: Tick the box to trust the new host key, or cancel.
error.release_not_pinned: This integration only installs releases whose checksum it contains, and the latest release is not one of them: {error}. Update the integration, or untick the install and add the panel for monitoring only.
error.nightly_not_allowed: Nightly builds are not installed from here: {error}
error.md5_fingerprint: MD5 fingerprints are not accepted: they are not safe to pin. Paste the SHA256 fingerprint (SHA256:...).

abort.unique_id_mismatch: The panel at that address is a different panel than expected: its Brilliant device id does not match.
abort.kiosk_not_active: The kiosk of this panel is not running (it was removed, switched off or failed to start), so the panel was not offered. Add it by hand under Add integration if you want to install or monitor it.
abort.device_id_unavailable: Home Assistant could not read this panel's Brilliant device id. It is what identifies the panel (the SSH host key changes when a panel is re-flashed), so the panel was not added. Brilliant's own software must be running: it restarts for a minute or two when the kiosk is switched on or off, and after a reboot. Wait a few minutes and try again.

progress.installing: Downloading and installing the kiosk on the panel. This can take a few minutes (the panel restarts its display services).

init.title: Brilliant Kiosk options
init.description: MQTT is never switched off: the panel always publishes its entities, either with the kiosk's built-in MQTT or through brilliant-mqtt.

data_description.mqtt_device_id: Required for brilliant-mqtt (MQTT_DEVICE_ID in kiosk.env): the kiosk's entities join that device.
data_description.manage_installs: Allow installing, updating and rolling back the kiosk from Home Assistant. Off by default when brilliant-mqtt manages the panel.
data_description.mqtt_provider: Who publishes the panel's entities over MQTT: the kiosk itself (built-in, KIOSK_MQTT=1) or the brilliant-mqtt project (KIOSK_MQTT=kiosk).

error.device_id_required: Enter the brilliant-mqtt device id (letters, digits, - and _).

abort.not_loaded: The panel is not connected right now.

release_not_pinned.message: {tag} is not in this integration's list of verified releases, so it will not be installed on a panel. Update the integration to a version that includes it.

confirm.description: Changing the MQTT provider of {host} needs a settings change on the panel, which failed: {error}. Select Submit to apply the chosen provider ({provider}) again.

error.apply_failed: The panel still refused the change: {error}

env_drift.title: Panel settings differ between the running and the saved copy

confirm.title: Reconcile the panel settings
confirm.description: The running settings of {host} (/etc/ha-kiosk/kiosk.env) and the saved copy that a reinstall or reapply rebuilds them from differ in: {keys}. A reinstall would drop or change these. Select Submit to write the running values to both copies (nothing is restarted).

abort.not_loaded: The panel is not loaded. Reload the integration first.

env_drift_unsafe.title: Panel settings differ and some cannot be fixed from Home Assistant
env_drift_unsafe.description:
The running settings of {host} (/etc/ha-kiosk/kiosk.env) and the saved copy (/var/lib/ha-kiosk/config/kiosk.env) differ in: {keys}. Of these, {unsafe} contain characters that are not allowed (quotes, backslash, $ or a backtick). Those files are read by shell scripts running as root, so Home Assistant never rewrites such a line, and this cannot be fixed from Home Assistant.

Fix it on the panel over SSH, in one of two ways. Edit the {unsafe} lines in /etc/ha-kiosk/kiosk.env to remove the characters; this issue then becomes fixable here and can write the values to both copies. Or run `ha-kiosk-setup reapply`, which rebuilds the running copy from the saved one and drops the running values.

set_env.name: Set settings
set_env.description: Merges settings into the panel's kiosk.env. KIOSK_MQTT and MQTT_DEVICE_ID (the MQTT provider) are refused: change them in the integration's options.

values.name: Values
values.description: Settings to set (KEY: value). Quotes, backslash, $ and a backtick are not allowed in values.

restart.name: Restart kiosk
restart.description: Restart the kiosk service after writing.

get_env.name: Get settings
get_env.description: Returns the effective settings (kiosk.env plus runtime overrides, secrets masked).

bus_get.name: Read bus variables
bus_get.description: Reads the variables of a Brilliant message-bus peripheral.

bus_set.name: Write bus variables
bus_set.description: Writes externally settable variables of a message-bus peripheral.

logs.name: Get logs
logs.description: Returns the last journal lines of a kiosk service, with the panel's address, ids, logins, IP addresses and anything that looks like a token or password removed (a best-effort scrub, as in the diagnostics).

unit.name: Service
unit.description: The kiosk service (systemd unit) to read.

install_version.name: Install version
install_version.description: Installs a specific kiosk release with ha-kiosk-setup. A stable release must be one this integration has a checksum for; a nightly needs the nightly channel.

tag.name: Release
tag.description: The GitHub release tag (v1.4.0, nightly-20261108) or the bundle version.
